title: Fixed Open Cuff and Offset Grip Forearm Crutch
description: One original complete fixed forearm-crutch visual prop: one full lower shaft bends back above a forward independent handgrip to a short offset upper stem. A thick C-shaped forearm cradle has a real open front sector and a complete finite inner wall, mounted through its rear saddle. A full grip core and dark sleeve, distinct fixed collar and a closed flared ground ferrule finish the single object. Not a shortened axillary crutch: no paired long rails, cross grip or underarm pad. One prop zero scenes, three opaque materials. Static empty public-service appearance only, no person, rehabilitation or medical suitability, fit, adjustment, load, balance, stability, human-contact assessment, manufacturing or safe mobility-device use claim. No rigging, animation or interaction.
